description: This file defines a standalone Angular component 'ItemListComponent' that displays a list of items in a table with edit and delete actions. It manages loading/error states and interacts with an API service to fetch and delete items.

classes.name: ItemListComponent
classes.description: A standalone Angular component that displays and manages a list of items, including loading, error handling, and delete functionality.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and loads items.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Fetches all items from the API and updates the component's state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the specified item after confirmation and reloads the item list.

methods.name: trackById
methods.description: Tracks items by their id or index for efficient rendering.
